business_problem: Tiryaki Agro, a leading agricultural products supply chain company worldwide, has been dedicated to providing healthy, reliable, and sustainable agricultural products since 1965. Confronted with the limitations of its legacy ERP system, Tiryaki Agro shifted to Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain. This move enhanced system responsiveness and streamlined reporting, enabling Tiryaki Agro to speed up its operations. Today, generating 12-month financial reports takes 30 minutes instead of a full day. Tiryaki’s team can collaborate on the fly, rely on more transparent and holistic financial data, and cut infrastructure costs.
solution_summary: Tiryaki Agro used Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dynamics 365 Finance, Power BI to move core workloads and data onto a modern cloud platform.
